hero.subtitle: The only Claude Code template where every agent <0>writes back</0> what it learned — and every project makes the <0>next one smarter</0>.
problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Every session starts blind.
problem.subtitle: You've been here. Smart agents, great work — then the session ends and it's all gone.
problem.reexplainDesc: Every new session needs a wall of backstory. Which packages to use, what decisions were made, where you left off. Wasted tokens, wasted time.
problem.silosDesc: Your spec agent doesn't know what the reviewer found. Your debugger doesn't remember the last three bugs. Each agent starts fresh, every time.
problem.staticDesc: You find a bug, fix it, move on. The next project hits the same bug. Every project reinvents the same wheel. None of your experience compounds.
problem.enforcementDesc: Agents forget rules. PyJWT becomes python-jose. Security patterns drift. Without automatic enforcement, every review is playing catch-up.
pipeline.label: The System
pipeline.subtitle: From spec to production, each agent has a defined role, a designated memory doc, and a model matched to the job.
learning.label: The Breakthrough
learning.subtitle: This is the part no other template does. A promotion engine that turns project-specific experience into permanent cross-project wisdom.
learning.step1Title: Agent finds bug in Project A
learning.step3Desc: Auto-compiled bootstrap doc. Every new project loads this on SessionStart, Day 1.
learning.step4Title: Project B never hits that bug
learning.step4Desc: The template warns you before you write a single line. Your experience compounds permanently.
features.label: What You Get
features.memoryDesc: Upload TECHSTACK.md to any Claude session and get full context back instantly. No re-explaining architecture, decisions, or current state.
features.enforcementDesc: SessionStart loads context. PostToolUse runs lint. SubagentStop triggers write-back. PreToolUse blocks DROP TABLE. All deterministic.
features.commandsDesc: /spec /implement /review /test /deploy /sync /update-docs /promote-learnings — the full dev cycle as composable primitives.
features.qualityDesc: RED → GREEN → REFACTOR is the only path. 80% coverage gate blocks deploy. @qa auto-validates PyJWT, bcrypt, cache tiers.
features.architectureDesc: TypeScript types auto-generated from openapi.yaml. Schema drift between frontend and backend becomes impossible by design.
features.deploymentDesc: @deployer runs all gates before touching git push. Server tests, client tests, openapi lint, TypeScript, git clean, correct branch. All must pass.
themes.label: Personalize
themes.subtitle: Click a theme card to preview it live. Your choice persists across sessions via localStorage.
structure.label: What's Included
structure.title: Clone. Run. Ship.
structure.subtitle: Everything pre-wired: agents, hooks, commands, memory docs, CI/CD, Dockerfiles.
cta.subtitle: Get the template used to build AI-Coding-Template — an AI agent pipeline that learns, remembers, and compounds.
